description: Cuts silent gaps inside a clip: any pause between transcribed words longer than minGapSec becomes a ripple delete (a small margin is kept so speech never clips). Typical minGapSec: 0.6 tight, 1.0 balanced, 1.5 loose.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.
